REQUEST
Write one text-to-image prompt for an empty sunlit stone courtyard with a dry fountain, ivy on the walls, and closed wooden doors. No people, animals, statues, silhouettes, or reflections of figures may appear. Return only the prompt and do not add a negative-prompt field.

OUTPUT A
A wide, eye-level view of an empty sunlit stone courtyard, centered on a plain, unadorned dry fountain with a visibly waterless basin, ivy climbing weathered walls, and closed wooden doors. Warm sunlight reveals textured paving and casts crisp architectural shadows; the scene contains only architecture and vegetation, with no people, animals, statues, silhouettes, or reflections of figures.

OUTPUT B
An empty, sunlit stone courtyard with a dry fountain, its bare basin completely free of water, ivy climbing the weathered stone walls, and tightly closed wooden doors. Warm sunlight reveals rough masonry and worn paving; the entire scene is unoccupied, with no people, animals, statues, silhouettes, or reflections of figures anywhere in view.

CRITERION C05-OUTPUT (hard)
The response is one prompt only and does not create an unsolicited negative-prompt field.

REQUEST
Create a ComfyUI wildcard file at `outputs/clothing-fragments.txt` containing exactly four distinct clothing-only fragments suitable for insertion at `[CLOTHING SLOT]` in this host: `score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up, source_anime, rating_safe, 1girl, black hair, [CLOTHING SLOT]`. Each fragment must be one nonempty physical line and describe only one garment or coordinated outfit; do not repeat the host prefix, subject, hair, pose, action, setting, camera, lighting, comments, numbering, headings, or blank lines. After saving, report the actual path, entry count, and that the file is fragment mode outside the file.

  "path": "outputs/clothing-fragments.txt",

}

}

CRITERION C16-FRAGMENTS (hard)
